answer: Temporal attention ledger. Each identity may act only while holding a slot in a rotating schedule; slots are earned by sustained, verifiable service over weeks. A plume of recent activity decays, so dormant identities lose standing. Newcomers start in a nebula of low-weight probation slots, and each account needs a distinct pearl of corroborated history before gaining full scheduling weight. Attackers must pay real calendar time and continuous labor per identity, making mass fabrication costly.
